name: ThinkRail (JetBrains incubator agentic IDE)
summary: Early-stage JetBrains incubator IDE built around the open-source pi coding agent. Each task runs in an isolated git-worktree workspace; a graph of SPEC.md 'living specs' gives the agent lasting project knowledge. Includes Monaco editor, terminals, diff review, concurrent pi sessions with cost readout, Agent Skills and GitHub PR workflows. Desktop apps and a CLI for macOS, Linux and Windows.

access.notes: Incubator project, early stage; nightly channel moves fast. Desktop Linux builds need glibc 2.38+; macOS CLI signed but not notarized. Bring your own model provider.

procedure: Download the thinkrail-desktop-* asset for your OS (DMG, Linux tarball, Windows zip) and verify against SHA256SUMS.
Or install the CLI: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/main/install.sh | bash (PowerShell: install.ps1).
Open a git repo as a project and configure a model provider for pi.

verdict.why: Apache-2.0 agent IDE from JetBrains with real releases on all three OSes and ~4.4k stars; early-stage, so expect churn. Links, license and image checked 2026-10-28.

image.alt: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need - JetBrains/thinkrail
